title: Forgotten Heroes of the Holocaust Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Forgotten Heroes of the Holocaust Congressional Gold Medal Act

This act provides for the award of a single Congressional Gold Medal to 60 diplomats posthumously in recognition of their brave and vital service of saving Jews during World War II. The single gold medal shall be presented collectively to the eldest next of kin of each of the 60 diplomats and then be given to the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum.

summary.headline: Congress awards one Congressional Gold Medal to 60 diplomats who saved Jews during World War II, honoring them after their deaths.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a single Congressional Gold Medal, awarded after death, to 60 diplomats for their service in saving Jews during World War II. The one medal is presented as a group to the eldest next of kin of each of the 60 diplomats. After that presentation, the medal goes to the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 12, 2024. The official summary does not give a date for the medal presentation.
